body:
## Summary

Add `cost(pattern, plan) -> Cost` to `DatasetView`, beside `cardinality_estimate`, so the optimizer orders joins by **work**, not row count. The cost covers rows, pages touched, and whether the read is resident.

## Why

Katamari ADR-0045 45.19 and `docs/design/PURRDF-SEAM.md` §2.2 at `e65fe50`. Katamari implements `DatasetView` over immutable segments, a resident delta tier, family indexes and cold pack reads, which differ in cost by orders of magnitude for the same cardinality.

The values are measured statistics the host keeps, never constants. The default implementation derives cost from `cardinality_estimate`, so existing views are unchanged.

## Acceptance criteria

- With a view whose costs invert its cardinalities, the optimizer chooses the cheaper plan.
- With the default implementation, plans are unchanged.
- Determinism holds.
title: DatasetView: a cost estimate beside cardinality, so joins are ordered by work
